introduction: Oregon unemployment applications and weekly claims use Frances Online. Complete the initial application before requesting individual weeks.
description: Oregon unemployment applications and weekly claims use Frances Online. Complete the initial application before requesting individual weeks.

sections.who: The Employment Department reviews covered work, separation circumstances and ongoing eligibility. Follow the ability, availability and work-search instructions for your claim.
sections.get: Approved benefits cover eligible claimed weeks. The system provides claim-status messages and a way to contact the agency.
sections.docs:
• Identity and employment records.
  • Employer details and separation information.
  • Weekly earnings, availability and work-search records.
sections.apply:
1. Apply through Frances

    Use the state filing guide to reach the claimant system.

  2. Keep the confirmation

    The agency sends a confirmation email after online submission. Check account requests.

  3. File weekly claims

    Use the weekly claim guide and accurately report that week’s circumstances.
sections.after: Monitor Frances messages and complete employment-service registration when instructed. Send a portal message if you need to correct a filing error.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Initial filing guide, Weekly filing guide, Frances account and corrections. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Does the application request every later week?
Where can I correct an error?
The agency directs you to message through Frances Online.
Is Frances used for other programs too?
It also supports Paid Leave Oregon; select the unemployment claim route for unemployment benefits.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
